rachel (sales): Acme POC flaky — intermittent TLS handshake failures to our private host during short load bursts. Demo tomorrow, need fast triage.

tom (acct): They report DNS -> interface IP ok. App logs: 'tls: certificate is not yet valid' and occasional 502/connection reset.

harry (eng-networks): Can they paste a failing curl -v and FQDN? Also capture tcpdump on ENI/NAT during a failure window. My gut: NAT egress churn or conntrack limits.

rachel (sales): FQDN: acme-poc.private.rdwdsvc.internal. curl output: 'SSL certificate problem: certificate is not yet valid' when resolved to 10.9.11.7.

nina (eng-runtime): Edge logs show tls handshake failures with client hello SNI and some 429s flagged by per-src rate limits around same time. If their egress IPs rotate quickly we can hit per-source throttles.

harry (eng-networks): Ask them to run: `sudo conntrack -L | wc -l` ; `sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max` ; `netstat -tan | grep TIME_WAIT | wc -l`. Also: `openssl s_client -connect 10.9.11.7:443 -servername acme-poc.private.rdwdsvc.internal -status`.

ops (acme-ops): Quick check: conntrack ~64.5k (cap 65536). We'll bump nf_conntrack_max now and retest.

nina (eng-runtime): We can temporarily whitelist their egress CIDR on the edge (POC) to avoid per-src rate cutting; need infra-security signoff. Also recommend app use keepalives to reduce new TLS handshakes.

harry (eng-networks): Durable option: Interface VPC Endpoint (PrivateLink) — eliminates NAT/eip churn and preserves SNI. If they go that route we provide the service name and security guidance.

deploy-bot: private-endpoint deployed zone-2 (ips:10.9.11.7,10.9.11.8). cert managed by Redwood, OCSP stapling enabled, exp:2025-02-02T00:00:00Z.

ops (acme-ops): Bumped conntrack to 200k; retesting.

ops (acme-ops): Retest: 2k RPS for 10m with zero TLS handshake failures. Looks stable.

rachel (sales): Great — closing demo blocker. We'll follow up on PrivateLink & POC sandbox pricing if they want to harden for prod.

tom (acct): They asked about cert rotation / OCSP for security questionnaire. Nina, can you paste a short blurb?

nina (eng-runtime): Blurb: "Redwood manages TLS termination for hosted private endpoints; certificates are proactively rotated, OCSP stapling enabled, and rotation events are auditable for enterprise customers. Customer-managed certs available for Private/Dedicated deployments."

harry (eng-networks): Next steps: leave thread open for PrivateLink if they decide to proceed; infra security to approve temporary whitelist if needed.

rachel (sales): Thanks everyone — fast turnaround saved the demo :rocket:
